description: This file implements the core runtime logic for 'Talk Mode' in an application, handling speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis (via external services and system voices), audio level monitoring, lifecycle management, configuration fetching, and command execution flow.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: A singleton actor managing the speech recognition, synthesis, and lifecycle for 'Talk Mode', including configuration, audio input monitoring, recognition sessions, and speech output, integrating various services and system components.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk runtime, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the talk runtime, managing recognition and UI states.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initiates speech recognition session, configured for the current locale and input device, with tap installation and task handling.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Terminates ongoing speech recognition tasks and cleans up resources.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates the noise floor estimate and determines if speech energy exceeds threshold, influencing recognition and UI updates.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition updates, manages phase transitions, and triggers further actions like play, send, or listen flows.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins background task monitoring silence duration to finalize speech input.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if sufficient silence has elapsed after last speech to finalize transcription.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Prepares the recognized transcript for sending and synthesis, updating UI state.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends recognized text to chat API, waits for response, and plays assistant speech output.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs contribution prompt for chat API, including interruption info.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for new assistant messages until timeout.

methods.name: latestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches the latest assistant message from chat history since a timestamp.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Coordinates TTS playback (via ElevenLabs or system voice) of assistant responses.

methods.name: playRemoteStream
methods.description: Plays synthesized audio stream with fallback options.

methods.name: playSystemVoice
methods.description: Synthesizes speech via device's system voice.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops current speech output, via PCM or MP3, and manages state.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Fetches and applies talk mode configuration settings.

methods.name: fetchTalkConfig
methods.description: Requests current configuration snapshot from gateway and parses relevant parameters.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Adjusts noise floor and speech detection thresholds based on real-time audio RMS levels.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves preferred voice alias or ID, defaults if necessary.

methods.name: resolveVoiceAlias
methods.description: Maps user-friendly voice alias to internal voice ID.

methods.name: isLikelyVoiceId
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a string resembles a voice ID.

methods.name: selectTalkProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects talk provider configuration based on supplied data.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves silence timeout setting with fallback.
